# Agent Codegen Protocol

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-agent-protocol-docs.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

> Online automation guide: [tavojs.dev/docs/cli/automation](https://tavojs.dev/docs/cli/automation)

Tavo machine protocol v1 is the stable canonical CLI + JSON contract for autonomous code generation. Compact context is limited to 8192 bytes; request full or targeted detail only when needed.

## Agent Loop

```bash
tavo agent-context --json --task modify-route --target /account
tavo inspect route /account --json
tavo change --from-json change.json --dry-run
tavo change --from-json change.json > receipt.json
tavo verify --receipt receipt.json --smoke --json
tavo build
```

Every JSON response uses the protocol envelope: `schemaVersion`, `command`, `ok`, project fingerprint, `data`, diagnostics, next actions, and output metrics.

## Tasks

- `create-route`
- `modify-route`
- `create-component`
- `modify-component`
- `add-loader`
- `add-action`
- `modify-store`
- `style-ui`
- `repair`

## Canonical APIs

### defineRoutePage

- Import: `@tavojs/core`
- Signature: `<TPath extends string, TData = unknown>(path: TPath, page: TypedPageModule<TPath, TData>): TypedPageModule<TPath, TData>`
- Use when: Opting into an explicit, path-aware type contract for a file-based page.
- Avoid: Do not add it when a plain default function and named route exports are sufficient.

### createTavo

- Import: `@tavojs/core`
- Signature: `<P extends AnyRecord, S extends AnyRecord, C = unknown>(definition: MvcComponentDefinition<P, S, C>): Component<P>`
- Use when: Building interactive reusable UI with model/controller/view ownership.
- Avoid: Do not invent React hooks or import React.

### defineGlobalStore

- Import: `@tavojs/core`
- Signature: `<T extends AnyRecord>(name: string, initialState: T | StoreInitializer<T>): Store<T>`
- Use when: Sharing application state across components and routes.
- Avoid: Do not store request users, tokens, or per-request authorization in server globals.

### defineValidatedAction

- Import: `@tavojs/core`
- Signature: `<TInput>(schema: TavoSchema<TInput>, handler: (context: ValidatedActionContext<TInput>) => Response | ActionResult | void | Promise<Response | ActionResult | void>, options?: PageActionOptions): PageAction`
- Use when: Accepting form or JSON mutations with structured validation errors.
- Avoid: Do not trust request input before schema validation.

### Seo

- Import: `@tavojs/core`
- Signature: `(props: SeoProps): Child`
- Use when: Adding ordinary route title and description metadata.
- Avoid: Do not build raw head HTML from user input.

## Structured Recipes

- **page:** `tavo generate page <name> --seo`; verify with `tavo verify --files <file> --json`.
- **loader-page:** `tavo generate page <name> --loader --seo`; verify with `tavo verify --files <file> --smoke --json`.
- **action:** `tavo generate action <name>`; verify with `tavo verify --files <file> --smoke --json`.
- **component:** `tavo generate component <name> --props`; verify with `tavo verify --files <file> --json`.
- **store:** `tavo generate store <name> --shape key,count`; verify with `tavo verify --files <file> --json`.
- **feature:** `tavo generate --from-json <spec> --dry-run`; verify with `tavo verify --spec <spec> --json`.

## Transaction Safety

Change plans use schema version 1 and apply atomically. Existing-file replacements, fixes, and deletions require the exact SHA-256 returned by `tavo inspect`; fixes that create a missing file use `expectedMissing: true`. A stale precondition rejects the entire plan before writes. Generated and build directories cannot be change targets.

Schemas ship under `@tavojs/cli/schemas`: protocol, context, diagnostics, change plans, change receipts, and evaluation results.

## Rules

- Pages are functional modules under `src/pages`; use `defineRoutePage` only for explicit route-aware typing.
- Interactive UI uses `createTavo`; do not invent React hooks.
- Shared state uses `defineGlobalStore` and must not hold per-request secrets on the server.
- Keep browser APIs out of loaders and server module initialization.
- Never edit `.tavo/generated` or `.tavo/build`.
- Finish with a production build after targeted verification passes.
